messages:
lee: Quick note 1: we're starting a small canary for v3.15.0 in 5m. plan: 1% -> 10% -> 100%. tagging rollback mini-runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-mini-v0.9 :warning:

deploy-bot: [deploy] release=v3.15.0 started \u00b7 slice=1% \u00b7 initiator=lee \u00b7 CL=GH:3662

anita: Heads-up: this touches streaming inference auth and embeddings subservice. rollback needs both a pin and an auth toggle revert. I've pasted quick commands below.

lee: Abort + pin commands (copy/paste):
```
# abort and pin to previous stable
./infra/deployctl abort --release v3.15.0 --reason "canary error"
./infra/deployctl pin --service text-gen --version v3.14.2
# revert auth flag if needed
./infra/featurectl set --service embeddings --flag streaming_auth --value false
```

mike (sre): Monitoring thresholds:
- errors > 1% for 5m -> abort
- p95 increase > 35% for 5m -> abort
- auth failures seen in logs -> immediate abort and flag revert

anita: Who's on manual unroute if deploy-bot fails?

lee: I'm primary for automation; Anita manual unroute fallback. Mike will escalate to eng-oncall if infra alerts.

deploy-bot: [status] slice(1%) healthy \u00b7 errors=0.08% \u00b7 p95=190ms \u00b7 elapsed=4m

anita: I'll draft a short release note: "v3.15.0 streaming auth fixes; gradual rollout. Rollback will pin back to v3.14.2 and revert streaming_auth flag."

mike (sre): Set a temporary alert to ping this thread at errors > 0.7% for 3m.

lee: please use single-line "ABORT: <reason>" if you see something that needs immediate stop so deploy-bot can act.

deploy-bot: [progress] promoted -> 10% \u00b7 release=v3.15.0 \u00b7 started=4890001117

lee: 10% looks good so far. will continue rollout per schedule and update runbook after the window with any clarifications. :white_check_mark:
